roadmap.title: Getting started
roadmap.description: Win your first maps, deploy upgraded towers and heroes, and try Powers.

roadmap.title: Monkey Knowledge, modes and medals
roadmap.description: Spend Monkey Knowledge, win restricted and special modes, and collect map medals.

roadmap.title: Pop and damage counters
roadmap.description: Pop or destroy large numbers of specific Bloons and deal heavy tower damage.

roadmap.title: Co-op
roadmap.description: Win and pop Bloons in co-op games, share cash and use Powers with friends.

roadmap.title: Races, challenges, Odysseys and dailies
roadmap.description: Race, create or play challenges, finish Odysseys and Daily Challenges.

roadmap.title: Trophy Store, Insta Monkeys, bosses and events
roadmap.description: Shop with Trophies, use Insta Monkeys, beat Bosses, play Monkey Teams and Golden Bloon events.

roadmap.title: CHIMPS, Expert maps and hidden challenges
roadmap.description: Beat CHIMPS under restrictions and complete the hidden achievements.

roadmap.title: Contested Territory, seasons and long grinds
roadmap.description: Capture tiles, earn season Stars and finish the longest grinds.

achievements.summary: Pop 100,000,000 Bloons.

guide.context: Pop-count goals are easiest to build before round 80.

steps.text: Keep playing normal games and popping Bloons until the total reaches 100,000,000.

achievements.summary: Destroy 25,000 MOABs.

steps.text: Play games and destroy MOABs until the total reaches 25,000.

achievements.summary: Destroy 10,000 BFBs.

steps.text: Play games and destroy BFBs until the total reaches 10,000.

achievements.summary: Destroy 5,000 ZOMGs.

steps.text: Play games and destroy ZOMGs until the total reaches 5,000.

achievements.displayName: Me Did A Job On DDT
achievements.summary: Destroy 5,000 DDTs.

steps.text: Play games and destroy DDTs until the total reaches 5,000.

achievements.summary: Pop 5,000,000 Fortified Bloons.

guide.context: A standard game from round 1 to 100 holds only 2953 Fortified Bloons, so Freeplay is the faster source.

steps.text: Pop Fortified Bloons across many games, continuing into Freeplay after round 100 for more of them.
steps.note: Avoid instant kills and abilities that strip the Fortified layer instead of popping it.

achievements.summary: Win a game on any Beginner map except the tutorial map.

steps.text: Win a game on any Beginner map outside the tutorial.

achievements.summary: Win on 9 different Beginner maps.

steps.text: Win one game on each of 9 different Beginner maps.

achievements.description: Win 1 game on an Intermediate map
achievements.summary: Win a game on an Intermediate map.

steps.text: Win a game on any Intermediate map.
steps.note: Sulfur Springs, KartsNDarts, Streambed, Downstream and Cracked are the easiest.

achievements.description: Win games on 5 different Intermediate maps
achievements.summary: Win a game on each of 5 separate Intermediate maps.

steps.text: Win one game on each of 5 different Intermediate maps.
steps.note: Sulfur Springs, KartsNDarts, Streambed, Downstream and Cracked are the easiest.

achievements.description: Win 1 game on an Advanced map
achievements.summary: Win a game on an Advanced map.

steps.text: Win a game on any Advanced map.
steps.note: Off the Coast is the easiest.

achievements.summary: Deploy a tier 4 tower.

steps.text: Place a tower and buy upgrades on one path until it reaches tier 4.

achievements.summary: Deploy a tier 5 tower.

steps.text: Place a tower and buy upgrades until it reaches tier 5.

achievements.description: Deploy a Hero on a non-tutorial map
achievements.summary: Deploy a Hero on any map except the tutorial map.

steps.text: Place a Hero in a game on any map outside the tutorial.

achievements.summary: Use a Hero's level 3 ability.

steps.text: Level a Hero to level 3, then use the ability it gains at that level.

achievements.summary: Use a Hero's level 10 ability.

steps.text: Level a Hero to level 10, then use the ability it gains at that level.

achievements.summary: Level a Hero to level 20.

steps.text: Play a game with one Hero until it reaches level 20.

achievements.description: Win a game for 4 different Heroes
achievements.summary: Win a game with each of 4 different Heroes.

steps.text: Win one game with each of 4 different Heroes.

achievements.description: Use Powers for the first time
achievements.summary: Use a Power for the first time.

steps.text: Use any Power during a game.

achievements.summary: Use Powers 25 times.

steps.text: Use Powers in your games until you have used them 25 times.

achievements.summary: Use Powers 100 times.

steps.text: Use Powers in your games until you have used them 100 times.

achievements.description: Apply your first Monkey Knowledge point
achievements.summary: Apply your first Monkey Knowledge point.

steps.text: Apply a @mechanic{Monkey Knowledge} point to any @mechanic{Monkey Knowledge} upgrade.

achievements.summary: Apply 10 Monkey Knowledge points.

steps.text: Apply 10 points to @mechanic{Monkey Knowledge} upgrades.

achievements.description: Unlock all Monkey Knowledge in one branch
achievements.summary: Unlock every Monkey Knowledge upgrade of one branch.

steps.text: Buy every @mechanic{Monkey Knowledge} upgrade in the Heroes branch, which needs the fewest points of any branch (13 in total).

achievements.summary: Spend 106 Monkey Knowledge points.

steps.text: Keep applying @mechanic{Monkey Knowledge} points to upgrades until 106 points are spent.

achievements.description: Win 10 games using only Primary monkeys
achievements.summary: Win 10 games while placing nothing but Primary monkeys.

steps.text: Win 10 games where every tower you place is a Primary monkey.

achievements.description: Win 10 games using only Military monkeys
achievements.summary: Win 10 games while placing nothing but Military monkeys.

steps.text: Win 10 games where every tower you place is a Military monkey.

achievements.description: Win 10 games using only Magic monkeys
achievements.summary: Win 10 games while placing nothing but Magic monkeys.

steps.text: Win 10 games where every tower you place is a Magic monkey.

achievements.description: Win 10 games using only Support monkeys
achievements.summary: Win 10 games while placing nothing but Support monkeys.

steps.text: Win 10 games where every tower you place is a Support monkey.

achievements.summary: Beat round 100 in Deflation mode.

steps.text: Start a game in @mechanic{Deflation} mode and survive through round 100.

achievements.summary: Beat round 100 in Apopalypse mode.

steps.text: Start a game in @mechanic{Apopalypse} mode and survive through round 100.

achievements.description: Win 25 games with Alternate Bloon Rounds
achievements.summary: Win 25 games that use the Alternate Bloon Rounds modifier.

steps.text: Win 25 games with the @mechanic{Alternate Bloon Rounds} setting enabled.

achievements.summary: Win 25 games on Impoppable difficulty.

steps.text: Win 25 games on Impoppable difficulty.

achievements.description: Win 10 games in Half Cash mode
achievements.summary: Win 10 games played with Half Cash mode.

steps.text: Win 10 games played with @mechanic{Half Cash} mode.

achievements.description: Win 25 games against Double HP MOABs
achievements.summary: Win 25 games with Double HP MOABs turned on.

steps.text: Win 25 games with the @mechanic{Double HP MOABs} option turned on.

achievements.description: Win a game in Reverse mode
achievements.summary: Win a game in Reverse mode.

steps.text: Win a game in @mechanic{Reverse} mode.

achievements.description: Get all medals for a map
achievements.summary: Earn every medal on a single map.

steps.text: Pick one map and win it in every game mode.
steps.note: Logs is the easiest map for this.

achievements.summary: Earn 36 difficulty medals on Beginner maps.

steps.text: Earn medals on Beginner maps until you hold 36.

achievements.summary: Pop 100,000 Purple Bloons.

steps.text: Pop Purple Bloons in your games until the total reaches 100,000.

achievements.summary: Pop 250,000 Camo Bloons.

steps.text: Pop Camo Bloons in your games until the total reaches 250,000.

achievements.summary: Collect at least 12 different Powers.

guide.context: Fourteen different Powers exist, so you can skip two.

steps.text: Keep earning Powers until 12 different ones are in your collection.

achievements.summary: Win a Daily Challenge.

steps.text: Open the Daily Challenge and win it.

achievements.summary: Win 10 Daily Challenges.

steps.text: Win Daily Challenges until you have won 10.

achievements.summary: Win 100 Daily Challenges.

steps.text: Win Daily Challenges until you have won 100.

achievements.description: Complete all Daily Challenges in a week
achievements.summary: Finish every Daily Challenge within one week.

steps.text: Complete every Daily Challenge available in a single week.

achievements.summary: Beat one map in CHIMPS mode.

steps.text: Pick any map, choose @mechanic{CHIMPS} mode and win.

achievements.summary: Beat 5 maps in CHIMPS mode.

steps.text: Win @mechanic{CHIMPS} mode on 5 maps.

achievements.summary: Beat 15 maps in CHIMPS mode.

steps.text: Win @mechanic{CHIMPS} mode on 15 maps.

achievements.summary: Destroy 1,000 BADs.

steps.text: Play games and destroy BADs until the total reaches 1,000.

achievements.summary: Beat one map in Co-op mode.

steps.text: Play a Co-op game with another player and win it.

achievements.summary: Beat a map in a Co-op game with 4 players.

steps.text: Play a Co-op game with 4 players and win it.

achievements.summary: Beat a map in a Co-op game with 3 players.

steps.text: Play a Co-op game with 3 players and win it.

achievements.description: Have 4 Heroes on screen at once
achievements.summary: Have four Heroes on the map at the same moment.

steps.text: Get four @item{Heroes} placed on the same map at once.

achievements.description: Win 10 games on Hard difficulty in Co-op mode
achievements.summary: Win 10 Hard-difficulty games in Co-op mode.

steps.text: Play Co-op games on Hard difficulty and win until you have 10 wins.

achievements.summary: Give 10,000 Cash in total to your partners in Co-op mode.

steps.text: In Co-op games, send Cash to your partners until the total you have given reaches 10,000.

achievements.summary: Give 50,000 Cash in total to your partners in Co-op mode.

steps.text: In Co-op games, send Cash to your partners until the total you have given reaches 50,000.

achievements.summary: Give 100,000 Cash in total to your partners in Co-op mode.

steps.text: In Co-op games, send Cash to your partners until the total you have given reaches 100,000.

achievements.summary: Give 1,000,000 Cash in total to your partners in Co-op mode.

steps.text: In Co-op games, send Cash to your partners until the total you have given reaches 1,000,000.

achievements.summary: Use Powers 10 times in Co-op mode.

steps.text: In Co-op games, use @item{Powers} until you have used 10.

achievements.summary: Use Powers 100 times in Co-op mode.

steps.text: In Co-op games, use @item{Powers} until you have used 100.

achievements.summary: Use Insta Monkeys 5 times in Co-op mode.

steps.text: In a Co-op game, place @item{Insta Monkeys} until you have used 5.

achievements.summary: Pop a total of 10,000,000 Bloons across Co-op games.

steps.text: Play Co-op games and keep popping Bloons until the total reaches 10,000,000.

achievements.description: Win 10 games with the hero Pat Fusty.
achievements.summary: Win 10 games using the hero Pat Fusty.

steps.text: Pick @item{Pat Fusty} as your Hero and win 10 games.

achievements.description: Before round 100, get 900,000 pops on a single Alchemist with the x-x-5 Bloon Master upgrades.
achievements.summary: Before round 100, reach 900,000 pops on a single Alchemist with the x-x-5 Bloon Master upgrades.

steps.text: Upgrade a single @item{Alchemist} to x-x-5 (Bloon Master).
Let it pop Bloons until its own pop count reaches 900,000 before round 100.

achievements.description: Complete a game in CHIMPS Difficulty with only 2 towers
achievements.summary: Complete a CHIMPS game while using only 2 towers.

steps.text: Start a @mechanic{CHIMPS} game.
Use only two towers all game, such as a 0-2-5 @item{Wizard Monkey} paired with a 5-2-0 @item{Dartling Gunner}, played on @loc{Logs}.

achievements.description: Finish a game with exactly half your starting lives and half your starting cash
achievements.summary: Finish a game with exactly half of your starting lives and exactly half of your starting cash.

steps.text: Finish a game when your lives and your cash are each exactly half of their starting amounts.

achievements.description: Send $500,000 to an ally in co-op in one go
achievements.summary: Transfer $500,000 to a Co-op partner in a single send.

steps.text: Build up at least $500,000 in a Co-op game.
Send $500,000 to your partner in one transfer.

achievements.summary: Enter 500 races.

steps.text: Enter races until you have entered 500.

achievements.description: Complete a Race in under 10 minutes
achievements.summary: Finish a race in less than 10 minutes.

steps.text: Finish a race with a time under 10 minutes.

achievements.description: Complete a Race in under 5 minutes
achievements.summary: Finish a race in less than 5 minutes.

steps.text: Finish a race with a time under 5 minutes.

achievements.description: Complete any Race in under 3 minutes
achievements.summary: Finish any race in less than 3 minutes.

steps.text: Finish a race with a time under 3 minutes.

achievements.summary: Create or play 200 challenges.

steps.text: Create or play challenges until the total reaches 200.

achievements.description: Win 100 games using a skin of any Hero
achievements.summary: Win 100 games while using a skin on any Hero.

steps.text: Equip a skin on a @item{Hero} and win games with it until you have 100 wins.

achievements.summary: Pop 200,000 Bloons on the map Peninsula.

steps.text: Play games on @loc{Peninsula} until you have popped 200,000 Bloons there in total.

achievements.description: Deal 1 billion damage with the Bloon Master Alchemist
achievements.summary: Do a total of 1 billion damage using the Bloon Master Alchemist.

steps.text: Use the x-x-5 Bloon Master @item{Alchemist} in games until its damage reaches 1 billion.
steps.note: Damage grows fastest in the late rounds.

achievements.summary: Reveal 10,000 Bloons using Shimmer.

steps.text: Reveal Bloons with Shimmer until the total reaches 10,000.

achievements.description: Place 50 Monkeys on a map at once
achievements.summary: Have 50 towers placed on one map at the same time.

steps.text: Place towers until 50 are on the map at once.

achievements.displayName: All for one and one for one
achievements.description: Win a game with only 1 Monkey on screen at any one time in any Hard Difficulty game
achievements.summary: Win a Hard difficulty game with only one tower on the map at any time.

steps.text: Start a Hard difficulty game and keep only one tower on the map all game.

achievements.description: Have 1000 lives at once in a single game
achievements.summary: Have 1000 lives at the same time in one game.

steps.text: Raise your lives to 1000 in a single game.

achievements.description: Pop 20,000 Rainbow Bloons with Magic Monkeys
achievements.summary: Pop 20,000 Rainbow Bloons using Magic Monkeys.

steps.text: Use @item{Magic Monkeys} to pop @enemy{Rainbow Bloons} until you reach 20,000.

achievements.description: Have a Vengeful True Sun God with a level 20 Adora on screen.
achievements.summary: Have a Vengeful True Sun God and a level 20 Adora on the map at the same time.

steps.text: Take the Monkey Knowledge @mechanic{There can only be One} from the magic branch.
Feed the Temple: 50,000 sacrifices across three categories for tier 4, then 50,000 across every one of the four categories for tier 5.
Build the second and third tier 5 @item{Super Monkeys} (the x-5-x one, plus the x-x-5 one) away from the Temple.
Get Adora to level 20 and have the Vengeful True Sun God on screen with her.

achievements.description: Win on any Expert map in CHIMPS after spending at least $40,870 on a single Spike Factory.
achievements.summary: Win on any Expert map in CHIMPS after spending at least $40,870 on a single Spike Factory.

steps.text: Start a @mechanic{CHIMPS} game on an Expert map.
Upgrade one @item{Spike Factory} to tier 5 so at least $40,870 is spent on it, then win.

achievements.description: Sacrifice every tower type in the game to the Temple
achievements.summary: Offer one of every kind of tower to the Temple as a sacrifice.

steps.text: Sacrifice one of each tower type to the Temple until every type has been sacrificed.

achievements.description: Complete a game of CHIMPS with more than 2 million damage dealt by one tower
achievements.summary: Complete a CHIMPS game with over 2 million damage dealt by a single tower.

steps.text: Start a @mechanic{CHIMPS} game and win it.
Make sure one tower's damage counter is above 2 million by the end.

achievements.description: Open a Diamond Crate in any Collection Event
achievements.summary: Open a Diamond Crate during any Collection Event.

steps.text: Play a Collection Event and open a Diamond Crate.

achievements.description: Have one of each T5 sniper in one game of CHIMPS
achievements.summary: Have one of each tier 5 sniper at the same time in one CHIMPS game.

steps.text: Start a @mechanic{CHIMPS} game.
Build all three tier 5 @item{Monkey Sniper} upgrades in the same game.

achievements.description: Have 200 insta-monkeys in your inventory at one time
achievements.summary: Hold 200 Insta Monkeys in your inventory simultaneously.

steps.text: Collect @item{Insta Monkeys} until your inventory holds 200.
steps.note: Insta Monkeys you have already used still count toward the total.

achievements.summary: Open the Daily Chest 365 times.

steps.text: Open the Daily Chest once per day until you have opened it 365 times.

achievements.description: Gain 10 levels for Adora in one round
achievements.summary: Gain 10 levels for Adora within one round.

steps.text: Sacrifice many towers to @item{Adora} with Ray of Doom in the same round until she gains 10 levels.

achievements.description: On the map Candy Falls, click all 8 Oompa Loompa monkeys in the correct order.
achievements.summary: Click all 8 Oompa Loompa monkeys on the map Candy Falls in the correct order.

steps.text: Open the map @loc{Candy Falls}.
Click the 8 Oompa Loompa monkeys one after another in the correct order.

achievements.summary: Complete an Odyssey.

steps.text: Play an Odyssey through to the end.

achievements.summary: Complete a Hard Odyssey.

steps.text: Play a Hard Odyssey through to the end.

achievements.description: Complete all 3 difficulties of a single Odyssey
achievements.summary: Complete all 3 difficulties of the same Odyssey.

steps.text: Pick one Odyssey and finish it on each of its 3 difficulties.

achievements.summary: Complete 12 different Odysseys.

steps.text: Finish 12 different Odysseys.

achievements.summary: Complete 50 Odysseys.

steps.text: Finish Odysseys until you have completed 50.

achievements.summary: Complete 100 Odysseys.

steps.text: Finish Odysseys until you have completed 100.

achievements.description: Complete an Odyssey in under 1 hour
achievements.summary: Finish an Odyssey in less than 1 hour.

steps.text: Finish an Odyssey with a total time under 1 hour.

achievements.summary: Buy any item from the Trophy Store.

steps.text: Earn Trophies, then buy any item in the Trophy Store.

achievements.description: Complete an Odyssey without using a Hero.
achievements.summary: Complete an Odyssey without using a Hero.

steps.text: Start an easy Odyssey and finish it without placing a @item{Hero}.

achievements.description: Beat 10 maps on Medium or harder using only large-footprint towers.
achievements.summary: Win 10 maps on Medium difficulty or harder using only large-footprint towers.

steps.text: Pick a large hero such as @item{Churchill} or @item{Pat Fusty}.
Win 10 maps with only large towers, such as a 0-4-2 @item{Monkey Buccaneer}, on Medium difficulty or higher.

achievements.description: Reanimate 250,000 bloons to fight on your side using the Necromancer Wizard
achievements.summary: Reanimate 250,000 Bloons to fight for you using the Necromancer Wizard.

steps.text: Use the Necromancer @item{Wizard Monkey} until it has reanimated 250,000 Bloons.

achievements.description: Win any non-CHIMPS/Impoppable game with only 1 life remaining
achievements.summary: Win a game outside CHIMPS and Impoppable and finish it with exactly 1 life.

steps.text: Play a Medium game and let your lives drop to 1 before you win.

achievements.description: Use the Alchemist's Transforming Tonic abilities 100 times
achievements.summary: Use the Alchemist's Transforming Tonic ability 100 times.

steps.text: Use the Transforming Tonic ability of an @item{Alchemist} until you have used it 100 times.

achievements.description: Create or Login to your Ninja Kiwi account to cloud save your progress
achievements.summary: Create a Ninja Kiwi account, or sign in to one, so progress is saved to the cloud.

steps.text: Make or sign in to a Ninja Kiwi account from inside the game.

achievements.summary: Win 10 Co-op games as the host.

steps.text: Host a Co-op game and win it; do this 10 times.

achievements.description: Strip the fortifications from Fortified DDTs 3000 times
achievements.summary: Strip the fortification from 3000 Fortified DDTs.

steps.text: Place a 0-2-5 @item{Mortar Monkey} aimed at the first bend of the track.
Take the Paint Stripper point in @mechanic{Monkey Knowledge}, then play games until 3000 Fortified DDTs have lost their fortification.

achievements.description: Submit a Challenge to the Challenge Browser
achievements.summary: Submit a Challenge you made to the Content Browser.

steps.text: Make a Challenge and submit it to the @loc{Content Browser}.

achievements.summary: Dartling Gunners must pop a combined 1,000,000 Bloons.

guide.context: Pops count layers removed, so earn them before round 80, while Ceramic Bloons are still plain Ceramics.

steps.text: Use @item{Dartling Gunner} towers in your games until they have popped 1,000,000 Bloons in total.

achievements.description: Spend at least 50 Trophies in the Trophy Store
achievements.summary: Use 50 Trophies to buy things in the Trophy Store.

steps.text: Beat the hard @loc{Odyssey} to earn 50 Trophies.
Spend 50 Trophies in the @loc{Trophy Store}.

achievements.description: Use a Tier 5 Insta Monkey. NOTE: even after being used, Instas still count toward your collection!
achievements.summary: Use a tier 5 Insta Monkey in a game.

steps.text: Get a tier 5 Insta Monkey, for example from round 100 on an Expert map.
Place that @item{Insta Monkey} in a game.

achievements.summary: Use 100 Insta Monkeys.

guide.context: Instas still count toward your collection after you use them.

steps.text: Place @item{Insta Monkeys} in your games until you have used 100.

achievements.description: Purchase at least 1 new Limited Time item in the Trophy Store
achievements.summary: Purchase one Trophy Store item that is marked Limited Time and that you do not own yet.

guide.context: Limited Time items are only on sale during holiday periods.

steps.text: Earn Trophies from Bosses, Races or Odysseys.
When a Limited Time item is on sale in the @loc{Trophy Store}, buy it.

achievements.summary: Upgrade towers 20,000 times.

steps.text: Buy tower upgrades in your games until the total reaches 20,000.

achievements.description: Win 100 games on maps that have removable obstacles while leaving every obstacle in place.
achievements.summary: Win 100 games on maps that have removable obstacles while leaving every obstacle in place.

steps.text: Play maps that have removable obstacles, such as Downstream on Easy, and win without removing any obstacle.
Repeat until you have 100 such wins.

achievements.summary: Collect 35 achievements.

steps.text: Earn achievements until you have 35.

achievements.description: Rope in 3,000 MOAB-Class Bloons using the MOAB takedown ability
achievements.summary: Use the MOAB Takedown ability to pull in 3,000 MOAB-Class Bloons.

steps.text: Use the MOAB Takedown ability of the @item{Monkey Buccaneer} on MOAB-Class Bloons until 3,000 have been roped in.

achievements.description: Redeploy 1,000 monkey towers using the Support Chinook
achievements.summary: Use the Support Chinook to move monkey towers 1,000 times.

guide.context: Each redeploy only counts if you move the mouse at least a little.

steps.text: Use the @item{Support Chinook} to pick up and move towers until you have redeployed 1,000.

achievements.description: Use emotes 100 times in co-op games
achievements.summary: Send 100 emotes while playing Co-op.

steps.text: Start a Co-op game and send emotes until you have sent 100.

achievements.summary: Pop 20 Golden Bloons.

steps.text: Pop every Golden @enemy{Bloon} you see until you have popped 20.

achievements.summary: Pop 100 Golden Bloons.

steps.text: Pop every Golden @enemy{Bloon} you see until you have popped 100.

achievements.summary: Pop 500 Golden Bloons.

steps.text: Pop every Golden @enemy{Bloon} you see until you have popped 500.

achievements.description: Pop 50 Golden Bloons in Magic Monkeys only mode
achievements.summary: In Magic Monkeys only mode, pop 50 Golden Bloons.

guide.context: That mode spawns 6 Golden Bloons per game, so plan on at least 9 games.

steps.text: Play @mechanic{Magic Monkeys only} games and pop every Golden Bloon until you reach 50.

achievements.summary: Win 25 games with Monkey Teams.

steps.text: Play the Monkey Teams event whenever it is running and win the game.
Repeat until you have 25 wins.

achievements.summary: Win 50 games with Monkey Teams.

steps.text: Play the Monkey Teams event whenever it is running and win the game.
Repeat until you have 50 wins.

achievements.summary: Win 100 games with Monkey Teams.

steps.text: Play the Monkey Teams event whenever it is running and win the game.
Repeat until you have 100 wins.

achievements.summary: Defeat a Tier 1 Boss.

steps.text: Play a Boss event or boss challenge and defeat the boss at Tier 1.

achievements.summary: Defeat a Tier 5 Boss.

steps.text: Play a boss challenge on an easy map such as @loc{Logs} and beat the boss at Tier 5.

achievements.summary: Defeat a Tier 5 Elite Boss.

steps.text: Beat the Elite version of a boss at Tier 5.

achievements.description: Upgrade to a Monkey Paragon Tower
achievements.summary: Upgrade a tower into a Monkey Paragon.

steps.text: Upgrade a tower into a @mechanic{Paragon} in a game.

achievements.summary: Pop 50 Boss Bloons.

steps.text: Fight bosses in Boss events or boss challenges until you have popped 50 Boss @enemy{Bloons}.

achievements.summary: Have a Paragon at degree 100.

steps.text: Take the @mechanic{Monkey Knowledge} point Master Double Cross and bring @item{Geraldo}, then place 17 paragon totems.
Pop about 16.5 million Bloons with Dart Monkeys and buy 100 tiers of Dart Monkey upgrades (tier 5s do not count), then build a Dart @mechanic{Paragon} with maximum investment to reach degree 100.

achievements.description: Win a boss battle without using a Hero
achievements.summary: Win a boss battle without placing a Hero.

steps.text: Start a boss battle with no @item{Hero} selected and win it.

achievements.description: Beat Spice Islands on Alternate Bloon Rounds with only land towers
achievements.summary: Win on Spice Islands in Alternate Bloon Rounds (ABR) mode, placing land towers only.

steps.text: Play @loc{Spice Islands} in ABR mode and place no water towers.

achievements.description: Beat Cornfield on CHIMPs without removing any corn
achievements.summary: Beat Cornfield on CHIMPS mode without removing any corn.

steps.text: Play @loc{Cornfield} in @mechanic{CHIMPS} mode and leave all the corn in place.

achievements.summary: Go $400,000 into debt.

steps.text: On @loc{End of the Road}, place 45 Monkey Banks at x-4-x.
Use the IMF Loan ability on each bank until its debt reaches 10k.

achievements.summary: Land 25,000 critical hits.

steps.text: Use towers that crit often, such as @item{Robo Monkey} or @item{Crossbow}, until you reach 25,000 hits.

achievements.summary: Glue 500,000 Bloons.

steps.text: Play @loc{In The Loop} on Easy. Bring Glue Hoses, a Druid of the Storm and @item{Bloon Solver}, and keep playing until 500,000 Bloons have been glued.

achievements.summary: Spend 1,000,000 cash during a single round.

steps.text: Turn off auto-start and save your cash.
Spend $1,000,000 in one round.

achievements.summary: Win 365 different Daily Challenges.

guide.context: Advanced and Co-op Daily Challenges count too.

steps.text: Win one Daily Challenge each day until you have 365 different wins.

achievements.description: Spend 1,000 MM on Continues or Checkpoints
achievements.summary: Spend 1,000 Monkey Money (MM) on Continues or Checkpoints.

steps.text: Pay Monkey Money for Continues or Checkpoints until you have spent 1,000.

achievements.summary: Capture 5 Contested Territory tiles from other players.

steps.text: Join a Contested Territory event and capture 5 tiles held by other teams.

achievements.summary: Capture 50 Contested Territory tiles.

steps.text: Keep capturing tiles in Contested Territory events until you have captured 50.

achievements.description: Capture 1 of each: Boss, Time Attack, Least Tiers and Least Cash tiles
achievements.summary: Capture one Boss tile, one Time Attack tile, one Least Tiers tile and one Least Cash tile.

steps.text: Join a Contested Territory team, then wait for an event to start.
Capture one tile of each of the four types.

achievements.description: Have 75 buffs active on your Monkeys at once
achievements.summary: Reach 75 active buffs on your monkeys at the same moment.

steps.text: Place nine 0-3-0 @item{Shinobi} (Ninja) towers close together.

achievements.summary: Complete a Quest.

steps.text: Start a Quest and finish it.

achievements.summary: Hold 150,000 Beast Handler XP at the same time.

steps.text: Earn Beast Handler XP until the total reaches 150,000.

achievements.summary: Earn 5,368,709 XP on a single tower.

steps.text: Grind XP on one @item{Banana Farm}, using boss challenge for full XP up to round 120.

achievements.description: Invest at least $401,626 extra when creating any Paragon
achievements.summary: Put at least $401,626 of extra money into building a Paragon.

steps.text: Build a Dart @mechanic{Paragon} and put in the maximum extra investment of $401,626.

achievements.description: Defeat 5 unique Bosses at Tier 5 (Can be in Boss Event or Challenge Mode)
achievements.summary: Defeat 5 different Bosses at Tier 5.

guide.context: Boss Events and boss challenge mode both count.

steps.text: Beat five different bosses at Tier 5, using easy maps such as @loc{Logs}, @loc{Cubism} and @loc{Resort} for boss challenges.

achievements.description: Win 100 different community submissions (Challenges, Odysseys, Maps)
achievements.summary: Win 100 different community submissions (Challenges, Odysseys and Maps).

steps.text: Open the @loc{Content Browser} and win 100 different community submissions.

achievements.description: Beat Spa Pits on Hard with Tar mode on, with no Monkey Knowledge and no Powers.
achievements.summary: Beat Spa Pits on Hard with Tar mode on, no Monkey Knowledge and no Powers.

steps.text: Switch off Monkey Knowledge and Powers, then open @loc{Spa Pits} on Hard Standard.
Before you press play, click the 4 steaming rocks to turn Tar mode on. Go bottom left, then top right, then top left, then bottom right.
Win the game. Water towers suit this map.

achievements.description: Free the frozen Cave Monkey on Frozen Over with 50,000 mortar shells.
achievements.summary: Drop 50,000 mortar shells on the frozen Cave Monkey on Frozen Over.

steps.text: On @loc{Frozen Over}, find the Cave Monkey stuck in the ice at the bottom right.
Use several 0-4-0 @item{Mortar Monkey} towers and spam the Artillery Battery ability on that spot until 50,000 shells have landed.

achievements.description: Complete the First Time Tutorial Quest
achievements.summary: Complete the First Time Tutorial quest.

steps.text: Finish the First Time Tutorial quest.

achievements.description: Achieve Tier 1 in any Stage in a Social Season
achievements.summary: Reach Tier 1 in any Stage of a Social Season.

steps.text: Play a Stage in the current Social Season until you reach Tier 1.

achievements.description: Earn 7,500 Stars in any Social Season
achievements.summary: Earn 7,500 Stars in a Social Season.

guide.context: Race events, Legends, Quests, Deflation, Advanced Challenges and Freeplay do not add Stars toward this.

steps.text: Play Social Season Stages, Daily Challenges and Boss events until you have 7,500 Stars.

achievements.description: Earn a perfect 15,000 Stars in any Social Season
achievements.summary: Reach the full 15,000 Stars in a single Social Season.

guide.context: You need every tier of every goal in both phases, and phase 2 opens a week after phase 1.

steps.text: Complete all tiers of all goals in phase 1.
Do the same in phase 2 when it opens.
